map.输入绳索破断强力与工作载荷，根据绳索用途类型计算实际安全系数、许用载荷并判定是否: Enter the rope's minimum breaking strength and working load to compute the actual safety factor and allowable load by rope use type, and determine whether the safety requirement is met.
map.绳索安全系数 SF = 最小破断强度 MBS ÷ 工作极限载荷 WLL，须 ≥: Rope safety factor SF = minimum breaking strength MBS ÷ working load limit WLL, and must be ≥ the minimum safety factor required by use type (rescue usually ≥ 5-10); checked against the use-type lower bound.
map.💡 公式：实际安全系数 SF = MBS / WLL；许用载荷 = MBS /: 💡 Formula: actual safety factor SF = MBS / WLL; allowable load = MBS / SF
map.安全系数参考 NFPA 1983 及 GB/T 24538 标准，不同场景可能有: Safety factors reference NFPA 1983 and GB/T 24538; different scenarios may have special requirements
map.绳索经使用后强度会下降，新绳计算结果不适用于旧绳: Rope strength decreases with use; results computed for a new rope do not apply to a used rope
map.绳结会使绳索强度降低 10%~50%，实际使用须额外考虑折减: Knots reduce rope strength by 10%-50%; a reduction must be considered additionally in actual use
map.动载荷（冲击）工况需使用更高安全系数，建议取静力安全系数的 2~3 倍: Dynamic (impact) conditions require a higher safety factor; 2-3× the static safety factor is recommended
map.本工具计算结果仅供参考，不可替代专业工程评估: The results of this tool are for reference only and cannot replace a professional engineering assessment
map.以上为常见尼龙/聚酯静力绳的参考值，实际请以产品标注为准。绳结折减参考：八字结约: The above are reference values for common nylon/polyester static ropes; in practice refer to the product label. Knot reduction reference: figure-eight ≈ -20%, bowline ≈ -30%, clove hitch ≈ -35% to -50%.
map.📚 深度解析：绳索安全系数校验: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: Rope Safety Factor Verification
map.救援、吊装、攀岩前按破断负荷与工作载荷核算安全系数是否达标。: Before rescue, rigging or climbing, verify whether the safety factor meets the standard from the breaking load and working load.
map.复核不同绳径/材质的安全系数差异，选择合规装备。: Re-check the safety-factor differences across rope diameters/materials to select compliant equipment.
map.培训中演示工作载荷超限如何拉低安全系数并触发预警。: In training, demonstrate how exceeding the working load lowers the safety factor and triggers a warning.
map.破断 30 kN、工作载荷 2 kN 的校验: Verification for a 30 kN breaking load and 2 kN working load
map.按默认参数（破断负荷 30 kN、工作载荷 2.00 kN）：实际安全系数 =: With the default parameters (breaking load 30 kN, working load 2.00 kN): actual safety factor = 30/2 = 15.00, minimum requirement 15:1, safety degree 100%; the tool rates it 'Pass', allowable load 2.00 kN, safety margin +0.00. If the working load rises to 3 kN, the safety factor drops to 10:1, reaching the lower limit and requiring re-selection.
map.安全系数 15:1 是通用标准吗？: Is a safety factor of 15:1 a universal standard?
map.不同场景要求不同：普通起重常取 5~6:1，救援/生命绳系统多要求 ≥10:1，: Requirements differ by scenario: ordinary lifting often uses 5-6:1, rescue/life-safety rope systems often require ≥10:1, and some high-risk two-rope systems require even more under extreme conditions; always follow the applicable code.
map.许用载荷怎么算？: How is the allowable load calculated?
map.许用载荷 = 破断负荷 / 要求安全系数；本例 30/15 = 2 kN，工作载: Allowable load = breaking load / required safety factor; here 30/15 = 2 kN, and the working load must not exceed this value, otherwise the safety factor is not met.
map.绳索安全系数计算工具，用于消防救援、高空作业、攀岩等场景下绳索选型与安全评估。输: A rope safety-factor calculator for rope selection and safety assessment in fire rescue, work at height, climbing and similar scenarios. Enter the rope's minimum breaking strength (MBS) and actual working load (WLL); the tool automatically matches the minimum safety-factor requirement by rope use type, computes the actual safety factor, allowable working load and safety margin, and gives a safety verdict.
map.支持 6 种绳索用途类型，自动匹配 NFPA 1983 / GB 标准最小安全系: Supports 6 rope use types with automatic matching of the NFPA 1983 / GB minimum safety factor

map.支持历史记录保存与一键恢复: Supports saving history and one-click restore
map.消防救援绳索救援作业前的安全评估: Safety assessment before rope-rescue operations in fire rescue
